mechanisms.name: Beneficial Gut Bacteria
mechanisms.description: Supports the growth, diversity and metabolic activity of beneficial gut microorganisms that contribute to digestive function, immune regulation, nutrient metabolism and overall host health.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps nourish the beneficial bacteria in your gut, supporting digestion, immunity and overall wellbeing.

mechanisms.name: Short-Chain Fatty Acid Production
mechanisms.description: Enhances microbial production of acetate, propionate and butyrate supporting intestinal integrity, immune regulation and metabolic health.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your gut bacteria produce beneficial compounds that nourish the bowel.

mechanisms.name: Gut Barrier Integrity
mechanisms.description: Maintains intestinal epithelial integrity by supporting tight junction function and regulating permeability.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps keep the gut lining strong.

mechanisms.name: Digestive Enzyme Activity
mechanisms.description: Supports production and activity of digestive enzymes involved in digestion of proteins, fats and carbohydrates.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your body break down food efficiently.

mechanisms.name: Microbiome Diversity
mechanisms.description: Promotes a diverse and resilient gut microbial ecosystem.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain a healthy variety of beneficial gut bacteria.

mechanisms.name: Nutrient Absorption
mechanisms.description: Supports efficient absorption and utilisation of nutrients across the intestinal lining.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps your body absorb nutrients from food.

mechanisms.name: Mucosal Health
mechanisms.description: Supports the health and maintenance of the gastrointestinal mucosal lining.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain the protective lining of the digestive tract.

mechanisms.name: Gastrointestinal Motility
mechanisms.description: Supports coordinated movement of the gastrointestinal tract.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps food move through the digestive system.

mechanisms.name: Intestinal Inflammation
mechanisms.description: Modulates inflammatory signalling within the intestinal environment.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain a healthy inflammatory balance within the gut.

mechanisms.name: Intestinal Epithelial Repair
mechanisms.description: Supports repair and regeneration of intestinal epithelial cells.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps the cells lining the intestine repair themselves.

mechanisms.name: Mucin Production
mechanisms.description: Supports production and maintenance of the protective mucus layer.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps maintain the gut's protective mucus layer.

mechanisms.name: Bile Acid Metabolism
mechanisms.description: Supports healthy bile acid metabolism and recycling.
mechanisms.plainEnglish: Helps recycle bile acids so fats can be digested efficiently.
